name: the TV streaming app
label: TV streaming app
customer_names: the TV app on my tablet

modes.title: Programmes will not play
modes.symptom: programmes stopping with a playback error after a few seconds
customer_says: The TV app won't play anything. I pick a show, it spins, and then I get an error message.
Every programme I try in the streaming app stops after a couple of seconds with something went wrong.
I can browse the app fine, but nothing actually plays. It just throws up an error code.
The app opens, the menus work, and then whatever I choose refuses to start.

causes.cause: a failed licence server for protected video
fixes: bringing a replacement licence server online

causes.cause: a corrupted batch of video segments at the regional cache
fixes: purging and refilling the regional video cache

causes.cause: an expired signing key on the stream packager
fixes: rotating the signing key on the stream packager

workarounds: watch through the web player at the Meridian TV site instead of the app
download programmes over Wi-Fi and play them from the downloads tab
aftercare: close the app fully and open it again
clear the app's stored data if the error message keeps appearing

modes.title: Constant buffering
modes.symptom: streams pausing to buffer every few seconds
customer_says: The streaming app keeps buffering. I get ten seconds of the programme and then the spinning circle.
Everything I watch in the TV app stops and starts. My internet is fine for everything else.
The picture keeps freezing and going blocky in the app. It is unwatchable.
Shows won't play smoothly in the app. It stutters all the time, even on the lowest quality.

fixes: adding capacity to the video delivery node

causes.cause: a faulty adaptive bitrate ladder published for the region
a peering fault with the content delivery partner
fixes: shifting streams to a second content delivery partner

workarounds: set the app's video quality to standard definition
cast from a phone instead of using the app on the television
aftercare: put the video quality setting back to automatic
restart the app so it reconnects to the nearest delivery node

modes.title: App keeps signing out
modes.symptom: the app returning viewers to the sign-in screen
customer_says: The TV app keeps throwing me out. I sign in and a minute later it asks me to sign in again.
I'm stuck on the login page of the streaming app. It accepts my details and then goes straight back.
The app won't keep me signed in. It is a loop, I log in and it logs me out.
Every time I open the TV app it wants my password, and then it says session expired.

causes.cause: a session token service returning short-lived tokens
fixes: correcting the token lifetime on the session service

causes.cause: a clock drift on the authentication servers
fixes: resynchronising the clocks on the authentication servers

causes.cause: a device limit counter that failed to reset
fixes: resetting the stuck device limit counter

workarounds: sign in with the pairing code shown on the television instead of a password
sign out of the app on every other device before signing in
aftercare: sign in once more to start a clean session
remove old devices from the device list in the account settings

modes.title: Live channels missing
modes.symptom: live channels missing from the guide
customer_says: Half my channels have vanished from the app. The guide is just full of gaps.
The live TV section is empty. On demand works, but there are no channels listed.
I can't find the sports channels in the app any more, and I definitely pay for them.
Channels I watch every day have disappeared from the list in the streaming app.

causes.cause: a channel line-up file published with missing entries
fixes: republishing the complete channel line-up file

causes.cause: an entitlement service timing out for subscription checks
a failed satellite feed into the regional encoding centre
fixes: switching the encoders to the backup satellite feed

workarounds: open a missing channel from the search box rather than the guide
watch the missing channels through catch-up an hour after broadcast
aftercare: pull down on the guide to refresh the channel list
sign out and back in if a paid channel is still missing

wrong_customer_side: an out-of-date version of the app
a television too old to run the app
a subscription that lapsed last month
a weak Wi-Fi signal near the television
wrong_provider_side: a rights dispute that has taken programmes down
planned work on the TV platform
a new version of the app being rolled out
